**Graysons Vault 0.5.0** restarts Qoin with its new numbers: **13.37 QNR a block** for the first year, then 4.25% less each year. All of it goes to the miner. There will never be more than **33,069,515.29 QNR**, and half of it takes about 16 years to mine.

The first launch paid about 263.88 QNR a block, toward a cap of 184 million. It ran for 17 blocks and is retired. Those blocks and their QNR are gone, so everyone starts even on the new chain. The launch time stays Thursday 8 October 2026, 13:37 Eastern. Graysons Vault → Node shows `chain b8b1ec3fefb96834`.

### Install

- **On 0.4.3?** Install `GraysonsVault.apk` over it. Your wallet, words and name stay. The app drops the old chain and syncs the new one.
- **On 0.4.2 or older?** Uninstall it first, install this, then tap **Restore** and enter your 25 words. That's the last time.
- **New here?** Install, tap **Create wallet** and write down your 25 words.

Temporal seals made on the old chain went with it. Your capsules and their words stay in the app; seal them again to put them on the new chain.

Check the file against `SHA256SUMS`. `GraysonsWallet.apk` is the same file under the old name, for old links. `frostnode.zip` is the server node: update it too, or it stays on the old chain. See [get.finux.tech/node](https://get.finux.tech/node/).

QNR has no guaranteed value. This is a proof of concept: expect bugs.
